title: tibouchina lepidota
intro: Tibouchina lepidota, commonly known as Glory Tree or Glory Bower, is a flowering plant species in the family Melastomataceae. It is native to Brazil and is known for its vibrant purple flowers and heart-shaped leaves. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure, reducing inflammation, and improving respiratory conditions.
